verses.text: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
“Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
lines: “Therefore my thoughts answer me,
even by reason of my haste that is in me.

verses.text: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.
lines: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame.
The spirit of my understanding answers me.

verses.text: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
lines: Don’t you know this from old time,
since man was placed on earth,

verses.text: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
lines: that the triumphing of the wicked is short,
the joy of the godless but for a moment?

verses.text: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,
lines: Though his height mount up to the heavens,
and his head reach to the clouds,

verses.text: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
lines: yet he will perish forever like his own dung.
Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

verses.text: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
lines: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found.
Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

verses.text: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
lines: The eye which saw him will see him no more,
neither will his place see him any more.

verses.text: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
lines: His children will seek the favor of the poor.
His hands will give back his wealth.

verses.text: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
lines: His bones are full of his youth,
but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

verses.text: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
lines: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth,
though he hide it under his tongue,

verses.text: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;
lines: though he spare it, and will not let it go,
but keep it still within his mouth;

verses.text: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.
lines: yet his food in his bowels is turned.
It is cobra venom within him.

verses.text: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
lines: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again.
God will cast them out of his belly.

verses.text: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.
lines: He will suck cobra venom.
The viper’s tongue will kill him.

verses.text: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.
lines: He will not look at the rivers,
the flowing streams of honey and butter.

verses.text: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.
lines: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down.
He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

verses.text: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
lines: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor.
He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

verses.text: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.
lines: “Because he knew no quietness within him,
he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

verses.text: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.
lines: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour,
therefore his prosperity will not endure.

verses.text: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
lines: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him.
The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

verses.text: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
lines: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him.
It will rain on him while he is eating.

verses.text: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
lines: He will flee from the iron weapon.
The bronze arrow will strike him through.

verses.text: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.
lines: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body.
Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver.
Terrors are on him.

verses.text: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.
lines: All darkness is laid up for his treasures.
An unfanned fire will devour him.
It will consume that which is left in his tent.

verses.text: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
lines: The heavens will reveal his iniquity.
The earth will rise up against him.

verses.text: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
lines: The increase of his house will depart.
They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

verses.text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
lines: This is the portion of a wicked man from God,
the heritage appointed to him by God.”
